name: variants/r1_s6
description: Monthly StochRSI pullback; stop at the previous week's low. No new entries while the NIFTY 500 index is below its 200-day average (NIFTY 50 / Sensex before mid-2006, when its 200-day average starts). [Trend exit swapped: weekly Supertrend(10,3) turns bearish instead of a monthly close below EMA61.] [Stack (10 slots, liquid-fund cash, 25-day time stop) with compounding risk.] [20% position cap + drawdown rule.] [Entry filter: NIFTY 500 index above its 200-day average instead of NIFTY 50 above its 200-day.] [Time stop: sell if not 0.25R up after 25 days (instead of 0.5R / 25).] [Supertrend exit only when it turns from bullish to bearish after entry] [Position cap also applied at entry: a new position is limited to 20% of equity when bought.] [1% risk, 6 slots]
